column1: # 23andMe internal-id  →  dbSNP RSID crosswalk
# 23andMe's chip reports some markers under proprietary "i" identifiers instead
# of standard Reference SNP cluster IDs (RSIDs).  SNPedia and GWAS datasets are
# keyed on RSIDs, so an "i"-only marker never matches unless it is translated.
# The complete i -> rs crosswalk has never been published by 23andMe, so this
# table is intentionally PARTIAL and community-extensible.  The resolver applies
# only what is listed here and leaves every other "i" id untouched — it never
# guesses.  See magic_mirror/iids.py.
# FORMAT   one mapping per line, tab- or comma-separated:
# Lines starting with "#" and blank lines are ignored.  Both columns are
# lower-cased on load.  Only clean "i<digits>" -> "rs<digits>" rows are kept.
# HOW TO ADD AN ENTRY
#   1. Open the marker's SNPedia page (https://www.snpedia.com/index.php/i713426).
#      Many "i" pages state their rs equivalent ("Make rs... ...") or redirect
#      to the rs page.
#   2. Confirm the chromosome + build-37 position matches your genome file's
#      row for that "i" id before trusting the mapping.
#   3. Append "i<id><TAB>rs<id>" below.
# Run `magic-mirror resolve` to see how many "i" markers in your genome this
# table currently covers and which remain unresolved.
# iid    rsid
